Use both lenses to size risk — neither is a trade signal.用两把尺共同控制仓位——两者都不是交易信号。

Top-risk gauge顶部风险表 ?
TOP-RISK GAUGE顶部风险表 Froth × Fragility狂热 × 脆弱
What it is这是什么 Two reads at once: how giddy the crowd is (euphoria) and whether big holders are quietly selling into the strength (hidden selling).同时看两件事：人群有多亢奋（亢奋度），以及大户是否在悄悄逢强派发（暗中派发）。
When it bites何时才危险 Only when both run high together — a giddy tape that insiders are distributing. Either one alone is just noise.唯有两者同时走高——亢奋的行情叠加内部人派发。任一单独出现只是噪音。

The full read完整解读
The map still says Stagflation, but current growth and inflation signs look like Reflation. Momentum is shifting back toward Stagflation, so the label remains unsettled. Today's main driver is hawkish Fed repricing. Markets are removing expected cuts, pushing short rates higher and supporting the dollar backdrop. 宏观图谱仍指向滞胀，但当前增长和通胀信号更像再通胀。动能正重新转向滞胀，因此标签仍未定。 今日主要驱动力是鹰派美联储重新定价。市场正在撤回降息预期，推动短期利率上升，并为美元提供支撑。
⚖︎ Where signals disagree⚖︎ 信号分歧
  • Rates versus credit: Short rates are rising, while credit remains tight and calm — pressure without a broad stress signal.利率与信贷：短期利率正在上升，而信用利差仍窄且平稳——存在压力，但没有广泛的紧张信号。
  • Dollar split: The dollar is falling now, while rate gaps still favor it — near-term relief rests on a fragile mismatch.美元分化：美元目前正在下跌，但利差仍对其有利——短期缓解建立在脆弱的背离之上。
  • America versus Asia: US liquidity is expanding, while China and Hong Kong liquidity is shrinking — global risk appetite lacks breadth.美国与亚洲：美国流动性正在扩张，而中国内地和香港的流动性正在收缩——全球风险偏好缺乏广度。
⛓︎ Chain reactions⛓︎ 连锁反应
  • If hawkish Fed repricing keeps up → higher borrowing costs pressure growth stocks, Bitcoin and long bonds如果美联储鹰派重新定价持续→借贷成本上升将压制成长股、比特币和长期债券
  • If the softer dollar keeps up → US and emerging-market stocks keep some support如果美元持续走软→美股和新兴市场股票将继续获得一定支撑
♻︎ Playbook check♻︎ 剧本对照
Bitcoin shows appetite for risk while China and Hong Kong liquidity is contracting, so the expected sequence is running out of order. Bitcoin显示风险偏好，而中国内地和香港的流动性正在收缩，因此预期中的传导顺序出现错位。
What to watch关注事项
  • ▹ Short rates reverse: The main driver is fading 短期利率反转：主要驱动因素正在消退
  • ▹ Credit spreads widen: Calm markets are becoming genuinely worried 信用利差扩大：平静的市场正变得真正担忧
  • ▹ China liquidity turns: Global risk appetite gains broader support 中国流动性转向：全球风险偏好获得更广泛支撑
  • ▹ Inflation cools further: Pressure for a hawkish Fed stance eases 通胀进一步降温：美联储维持鹰派立场的压力缓解
